PowerShell($headers = @{"Accept"="application/json"; "X-Tenant-Id"="prakritiz"}; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://emgroup.sabyaroy.com/api/products?page=1" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 15; $list = if \($r -is [array]\) { $r } else { $r.data }; Write-Host "Total products: $\($list.Count\)"; Write-Host "Keys in product: $\(\($list[0] | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name -join ', '\)"; $list | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "id=$\($_.id\) name=$\($_.name\) base=$\($_.base_price\) sale=$\($_.sale_price\) img=$\($_.main_image\)" })

PowerShell($headers = @{"Accept"="application/json"; "X-Tenant-Id"="prakritiz"}; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://emgroup.sabyaroy.com/api/products/oil" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 15; $prod = if \($r.data\) { $r.data } else { $r }; Write-Host "=== SINGLE PRODUCT FIELDS ==="; \($prod | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name | ForEach-Object { $val = $prod.$_; $type = if \($val -is [array]\) {"array[$\($val.Count\)]"} elseif \($val -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]\) {"object: $\(\($val | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name -join ','\)"} else { "\($\($val.GetType\(\).Name\)\): $val" }; Write-Host "$_ = $type" })

PowerShell($headers = @{"Accept"="application/json"; "X-Tenant-Id"="prakritiz"}; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://emgroup.sabyaroy.com/api/products/oil" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 15; $prod = $r.data.product; if \(-not $prod\) { $prod = $r.product }; Write-Host "=== INNER PRODUCT ==="; \($prod | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name | ForEach-Object { $val = $prod.$_; $type = if \($val -is [array]\) {"array[$\($val.Count\)]"} elseif \($val -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]\) {"object{$\(\($val | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name -join ','\)}"} else { "\($\($val.GetType\(\).Name\)\): $val" }; Write-Host "$_ = $type" })

PowerShell($headers = @{"Accept"="application/json"; "X-Tenant-Id"="prakritiz"}; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://emgroup.sabyaroy.com/api/hero-banners" -Headers $headers -TimeoutSec 15; $list = if \($r -is [array]\) { $r } elseif \($r.data\) { $r.data } else { @\($r\) }; Write-Host "Count: $\($list.Count\)"; if \($list.Count -gt 0\) { $b = $list[0]; \($b | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name | ForEach-Object { $val = $b.$_; if \($null -eq $val\) { Write-Host "$_ = null" } elseif \($val -is [array]\) { Write-Host "$_ = array[$\($val.Count\)]" } elseif \($val -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]\) { Write-Host "$_ = object{$\(\($val | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty\).Name -join ','\)}" } else { Write-Host "$_ = \($\($val.GetType\(\).Name\)\): $val" } } })
